decisive_items: 20×20 mm round cystic mass at the base of the tongue
33×31×27 mm well-defined cystic lesion in the midline of the tongue base
complete pharyngeal airway obstruction during both inspiration and expiration as the mass pulled the epiglottis down and backward
response.rationale: The cystic tongue-base mass is the underlying structural lesion causing the obstructive sleep apnea; OSA is a downstream manifestation rather than the primary diagnosis.

rejected.why: Obstructive sleep apnea describes the physiologic consequence, but the most likely diagnosis is the causative cystic mass at the tongue base.
